C0886.title: Suspected Leak of 170 Million User Records from Chaoxing Learning Platform
C0886.summary: In June 2022, reports claimed that a database from the Chaoxing Xuexitong learning app was being sold through illicit channels, allegedly involving 172.73 million records containing names, phone numbers, gender, schools, student or staff IDs, and email addresses. Xuexitong said it had launched a technical investigation and had not found clear evidence of a user information leak, stressed that it did not store plaintext passwords, and reported the matter to police because of its significance.
